assertions.name: self_dual_part_changes_sign

assertions.name: paired_part_changes_sign

assertions.name: positive_definiteness_bounds_hold
assertions.note: sum_{h in H} A(h) >= 0 for H = Z/3 and H = A_4, where A = sum_lam f^lam e_lam is positive. BOTH ARE LOWER BOUNDS; the conjecture is an upper bound, so this structure is sign-blind in the needed direction

assertions.name: odd_classes_vanish_by_omega_orthogonality
assertions.note: P_k = sum (f^lam)^2 s_lam is omega-invariant, p_mu is omega-anti-invariant for odd mu, and omega is an isometry of the Frobenius pairing -- so the two are orthogonal
